## NVCA Resources

NVCA is a nonprofit association powered by our members. We convene venture capital investors, entrepreneurs, and industry partners to shape public policy priorities, to develop new industry initiatives, to provide premier research, and to participate in professional development opportunities with their peers.

## Upcoming Events

### [Q1 2026 PitchBook-NVCA Venture Monitor Webinar](https://nvca.org/event/q1-2026-pitchbook-nvca-venture-monitor-webinar/)

May 28, 2026

Don’t miss the Q1 2026 PitchBook-NVCA Venture Monitor Webinar. During the discussion, industry experts from PitchBook, NVCA, J.P. Morgan, Dentons, and EisnerAmper will share insights from the Q1 2026 PitchBook-NVCA report—from AI’s impact on investment and liquidity to the extreme concentration defining where deals get done and what’s getting funded.

Featuring:

- Carly Roddy, Manager Director and Co-leads the Global Banking Venture Capital Coverage, J.P. Morgan
- Ryan Keating, Partner, Eisner Advisory Group LLC
- Kyle Stanford, Director, VC Research, CAIA, PitchBook
- Shiloh Tillemann-Dick, Research Director, NVCA
- James Jasaitis, Partner, Venture Technology & Emerging Growth, Dentons

[READ MORE](https://nvca.org/event/q1-2026-pitchbook-nvca-venture-monitor-webinar/ "Q1 2026 PitchBook-NVCA Venture Monitor Webinar")

### [VC Unlocked: AI Edition by 500 Global](https://nvca.org/event/vc-unlocked-ai-edition-by-500-global/)

June 1, 2026

As AI becomes increasingly central to venture investing, 500 Global has designed a focused program for experienced investors and fund managers who want to deepen their AI expertise and sharpen their ability to identify, evaluate, and invest in high-quality AI startups.

This 4-day, in-person program conducted in the San Francisco Bay area aims to spark meaningful dialogue and challenge conventional thinking. Through curated discussions and contrarian debates, the program seeks to help investors gain confidence in evaluating AI startups while connecting them with global AI funds, founders, and ecosystem partners.

Hear from a carefully selected lineup of some of the leading AI investors and practitioners who are actively shaping the future of the AI ecosystem. **Applications are open through April 30 for the June 1–4 program.**

[READ MORE](https://nvca.org/event/vc-unlocked-ai-edition-by-500-global/ "VC Unlocked: AI Edition by 500 Global")

### [2026 IS:CleanTech Ecosystem Summit](https://nvca.org/event/2026-iscleantech-ecosystem-summit/)

June 4, 2026

IS: CleanTech is a premier one-day conference connecting the region’s clean technology startup and innovation ecosystem.

Bringing together entrepreneurs, industry leaders, investors, and ecosystem partners, this summit highlights groundbreaking solutions in climate tech, sustainability, and clean energy.

Attendees will engage with emerging startups, cutting-edge innovations, and market trends driving the future of clean technology. Through insightful discussions, networking opportunities, and pitches, IS: CleanTech fosters collaboration and accelerates the transition toward a more sustainable and resilient world.

[READ MORE](https://nvca.org/event/2026-iscleantech-ecosystem-summit/ "2026 IS:CleanTech Ecosystem Summit")

### [2026 NVCA Strategic Operations & Policy Summit](https://nvca.org/event/2026-nvca-strategic-operations-policy-summit/)

October 14, 2026

**About this event**

This 1.5-day conference, developed in collaboration with [NVCA’s CFO Taskforce,](https://nvca.org/peer-groups/) focuses on the critical role senior operations professionals play in venture firms, and how they can provide value back to their partnerships. The agenda emphasizes best practices, technical topics, professional development, and industry related policy content, several opportunities for networking.

**Participants** will have the opportunity to develop functional expertise, troubleshoot shared challenges, and earn CPE credit hours for attending.

More information to come.

[READ MORE](https://nvca.org/event/2026-nvca-strategic-operations-policy-summit/ "2026 NVCA Strategic Operations & Policy Summit")
